answer: Because the prism salt is published after the timber checkpoint, the kernel audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 75 keys thus burns for 75 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 171 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
